name: Friedrichsthal (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Friedrichsthal (a lion on blue above crossed tools on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Friedrichsthal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Friedrichsthal arms — lion and crossed tools
